title: W-7: ward status names another project's stale approvals for an unregistered checkout
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-7 (medium). status picks the project from the tracked manifest UUID and names stale approvals (profile names, checkout paths, versions, hints) for whatever project that UUID claims, with no local binding. Files: src/application/reporting.ts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Only a matching local binding authorises naming vault metadata; an unregistered or conflicting checkout gets aggregate counts only
Copied-manifest and conflicting-binding tests exist for both status and doctor, including deleted checkouts
